scope.exclude: Artifacts and work first created for GL/RM on or after 2026-07-14; pre-existing live evidence later cited by GL/RM remains eligible from its original source.

forbidden: change live or canary runtime configuration

corpus_completeness_rule.method: Build a path-level manifest of every regular file in the required source families, record size and SHA256, and parse every bounded text/JSON/CSV/log/source file rather than sample. Binary/model artifacts are hashed and their adjacent metadata plus code loading semantics are read; binary bytes are not interpreted as prose.
corpus_completeness_rule.date_rule: Use embedded event timestamps for event inclusion. File mtime is inventory metadata only and does not override an in-window embedded timestamp. Source/config state is reconstructed from contemporaneous audit snapshots, run logs, and git history where available.
corpus_completeness_rule.quote_rule: A quote, simulation, estimate, proposal, prepared transaction, or submitted hash without a successful receipt is never a fill.

all_required: Contemporaneous evidence says dry_run=false or equivalently armed real execution.
A syntactically valid transaction hash exists on Base chain 8453.
eth_getTransactionReceipt returns a receipt with status=1.
Receipt transaction/log evidence proves a wallet-relevant asset movement for the claimed leg; a mere approval or unrelated transaction is not a trade.
real_successful_fill.attempt_not_fill: dry_run=false with missing receipt, status=0, approval-only logs, or no claimed wallet asset movement.
real_successful_fill.paper_or_canary_dry: dry_run=true, paper/shadow/simulation/QV2-only rows, or canary records without a matching successful real receipt and wallet asset movement.
real_successful_fill.unknown: Insufficient evidence remains unknown and is excluded from real-fill aggregates, with the exclusion listed explicitly.

cash_flow.native_in_out: Derive transaction value and native/WETH movements from the canonical transaction and receipt logs; normalize ETH and WETH 1:1 in WETH units while retaining the raw components.
cash_flow.token_in_out: Decode ERC-20 Transfer logs using on-chain token decimals at the receipt block where available.
cash_flow.gas: gas_used * effective_gas_price from the successful receipt, paid by tx.from; allocate each leg's gas to its matched round trip.
cash_flow.matching: Match BUY and SELL legs by wallet, pool/token and contemporaneous position identity. Use FIFO only if multiple indistinguishable lots overlap. Do not realize unsold inventory.
cash_flow.realized_pnl_weth: WETH/ETH proceeds minus WETH/ETH cost basis minus successful-leg gas. Failed attempts are reported separately and their gas is included only if receipt status=0 and tx.from is the live wallet, but they do not become fills.
cash_flow.cumulative_invested_weth: Sum successful real BUY principal actually paid, excluding gas and excluding quotes.
cash_flow.win: A closed matched round trip with realized_pnl_weth > 0 after all matched-leg gas.
cash_flow.worst_trade: Minimum realized_pnl_weth among closed matched real round trips.

usd_conversion.source: Project-pinned on-chain ETH/USD oracle on Base, queried read-only at each receipt block; never substitute an off-chain spot price.
usd_conversion.time_rule: Use the latest oracle round whose updatedAt is not after the receipt block timestamp. Record feed address, round, answer, decimals and updatedAt.
usd_conversion.failure_rule: If a historical oracle value cannot be proven, report USD as null/unknown rather than interpolate or use today's price.

configuration_reconstruction.segments: Start a new segment at every evidenced go-live, pause, restart, or parameter/model/risk-gate change.
conflict_priority: contemporaneous runtime log or immutable session snapshot
git history at the segment timestamp
configuration_reconstruction.unknown_rule: Do not fill a missing runtime value with a current default; mark it unknown.

attribution_waterfall.identity: execution_gap + rug_realization + regime_decay + selection_timing + small_sample_residual == actual_realized_pnl_weth
attribution_waterfall.counterfactual: For each real closed trade, reconstruct same-block QV2 and, where available, atomic executable buy/sell amounts at the actual sizes and pinned fee/path. Counterfactual includes the preregistered gas convention and never treats a quote as an observed fill.

priority.amount: actual realized PnL minus the same-block executable counterfactual PnL for each closed trade
priority.unknown: If same-block counterfactual cannot be reproduced, this component is null for that trade and moves to the residual, not zero.

priority.amount: Remaining same-block counterfactual PnL for trades independently classified as rug/fatal before looking at PnL magnitude.
priority.classification: Requires contemporaneous rug/fatal evidence tied to the pool plus on-chain liquidity/removal, sell restriction, or exit-path evidence. A large loss alone is insufficient.

priority.amount: Remaining same-block counterfactual PnL for non-rug trades in a live segment whose candidate density/quoteability/market condition is demonstrably outside the +56% estimator's pinned sample regime.
priority.classification: Requires a full-period inventory metric, not a hand-picked date anecdote.

priority.amount: Remaining same-block counterfactual PnL for non-rug trades when the complete candidate inventory supports an open-window versus paused-window timing difference.
priority.classification: Requires the full eligible candidate set and exact open/paused windows; otherwise zero identified amount and diagnose only as unknown.

priority.amount: All remaining PnL, including unidentifiable counterfactual components, such that the identity holds exactly.
priority.diagnostics: Report n, win rate, sample standard deviation where n permits, exact/binomial uncertainty, and +56% benchmark probability where its per-trade distribution is reproducible. Residual is not proof that noise caused the loss.

attribution_waterfall.reporting_rule: Report both the exact additive waterfall and non-additive diagnostics. Do not present overlap-prone diagnostics as additive causal proof.

overturn_iron_if_any: Real receipts show a material systematic actual-fill versus same-block executable gap large enough to reverse the +56% historical estimate under the same strategy/configuration.
The +56% estimator used quotes, in-sample rug survivorship, omitted fatal sell outcomes, or a materially different configuration without an honest scope label, and correction reverses the claim.
The purported historical fact is not reproducible under its frozen hashes or contains an accounting identity failure.
adjudication.compatible_only_if: The +56% remains a correctly scoped historical estimate under its own frozen sample and executable assumptions, while real losses are quantitatively explained or remain statistically compatible through configuration mismatch, rug realization, regime, timing, and/or small n. Compatibility does not establish forward net edge.
adjudication.gl1_02_rule: GL1-02 is decided from successful receipt-verified real fills only: positive realized net edge => evidence-positive at observed tiny scale; negative => FAIL for observed live sample; no or unmatched fills => OPEN/INCONCLUSIVE. A negative tiny sample may coexist with a historical alpha fact but cannot be relabeled positive.
